sources.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Create a precisely aligned 3-column by 2-row sheet of SIX separate small illustrated UI decoration assets. Use the reference calico cat's rounded Japanese stationery style, dark cocoa outline, matte ivory/caramel/black patches and blush-pink inner ears. Canvas1024x1024. Each equal cell contains one complete isolated part, large green margins with no part touching a cell edge. No separators, labels, text, scenery, shadow, glow or gradient.
Top left: just the calico cat HEAD, slightly tilted, eyes CLOSED asleep, with both ears. No neck or body.
Top middle: only a cute upward-curled thick calico cat TAIL, cream base with caramel and black patches. Distinct single tail silhouette, no body.
Top right: only THREE gently curved dark cocoa cat whisker strokes fanning leftward from one shared point at the right edge of the shape. No face, no dots, no framing shape. Slightly thick smooth strokes readable at32pixels wide.
Bottom left: only THREE gently curved dark cocoa whisker strokes fanning rightward from one shared point at the left edge, mirrored partner of top-right. No face, dots or framing shape.
Bottom middle: only a LEFT cat ear, a softly rounded triangular pointed cream ear with blush-pink inner triangle and caramel outer patch, dark cocoa outline, flat horizontal base. No face or body. Slight outward lean.
Bottom right: only the matching RIGHT cat ear, softly rounded triangular pointed ear with blush-pink interior, dark cocoa outer fur patch and a flat horizontal base. No face or body. Slight outward lean.
Background MUST be perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 outside each asset for clean removal. No green in any part. Do not draw a checkerboard. Keep parts clean, simple and pleasant at small sizes. Use the supplied illustration only as a style and palette reference.

Use case: illustration-story
Reference: use the cat identity, asymmetrical calico markings and warm cream/peach/pink/black palette of the provided illustration. No text or lettering anywhere. No green in any subject. Background must be perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00ff00, no shadows or gradients.
Create a carefully aligned 2 by 2 sprite sheet of four separate cute polished stationery-style spot illustrations, one per equal square quadrant of a1024x1024 canvas. Every icon isolated with generous empty green margin, no dividers or labels. Keep every subject entirely within its cell. Bold warm cocoa outlines, flat matte colours, crisp small-scale readable silhouette. SAME round cream/caramel/black cat family throughout.
Top left: only a cheerful calico cat HEAD looking forward, with two cute ears and tiny smiling mouth. Brand icon, no objects.
Top right: only a friendly calico cat HEAD with a tiny peach bow tie directly beneath its chin. Character avatar placeholder.
Bottom left: only a friendly calico cat HEAD with a small blush-pink collar and heart-shaped tag beneath its chin. User persona avatar placeholder.
Bottom right: a small cream notepad with one peach folded page corner and a simple pink paw-print stamp, with a small calico cat peeking over its top edge. Note/comment icon, no lines of text.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a small cute Neconyan UI illustration in the exact same illustrated family as the reference.
The reference is a STYLE AND CAT IDENTITY reference, not a scene to reproduce. Keep its warm hand-drawn cocoa outline, rounded calico anatomy, asymmetric ivory/black/caramel patches, pink inner ears and nose, subtle cheek blush, simple polished Japanese stationery style. Flat matte colours, minimal shading. Strong clean silhouette readable at 120 pixels wide.
Composition: a single compact isolated vignette centred in the image, 16% empty margin all round. Nothing clipped. No text, letter-like marks, watermark, square sticker outline, ground plane, drop shadow, glow, environment or background gradients.
Background: completely uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 outside the vignette for clean background removal; no green in cat or objects. Do not draw a checkerboard.
Primary request: the same cute round calico cat sitting happily with its front paws resting on a small closed cream notebook above one apricot book. A little blush-pink ribbon bookmark sticks out. Cat has content closed smiling eyes, upright ears and its tail curled around the books. No speech bubble, heart or magnifying glass. No writing, symbols or fake text on the books. The entire cat and books fit within the vignette.

The reference is a STYLE AND CAT IDENTITY reference, not a scene to reproduce. Keep its warm hand-drawn cocoa outline, rounded calico anatomy, asymmetric ivory/black/caramel patches, pink inner ears and nose, subtle cheek blush, simple polished Japanese stationery style. Flat matte colours, minimal shading. Strong clean silhouette readable at 120 pixels wide.

Background: completely uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 outside the vignette for clean background removal; no green in cat or objects. Do not draw a checkerboard.
Primary request: the same cute round calico cat looking curiously through a small peach-handled magnifying glass, with one paw holding its handle. The cat has big warm dark eyes and its head tilted gently to one side. Lens is uncoloured and clear, the same green background visible through the empty part. One tiny blush-pink sparkle beside its ear. No speech bubble or heart. The entire cat, paws, tail and glass fit within the vignette.

Use case: illustration-story
Reference: use the cat identity, asymmetrical calico markings and warm cream/peach/pink/black palette of the provided illustration. No text or lettering anywhere. No green in any subject. Background must be perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00ff00, no shadows or gradients.
Create a precisely aligned 3 by 3 sprite sheet of the SAME cute small calico cat in nine animation poses.1024x1024 canvas; each equal cell contains one complete isolated full-body sprite, centred with at least18% empty green margin. No dividers, frames or labels. All nine cats have the same scale, body proportions and markings. STYLE: genuine clean chunky pixel art, visible square pixels, limited cream/peach/brown/black/pink palette, no anti-aliasing, no gradients. Cat is rounded and irresistibly cute, small paws, pointed ears, curled tail, pink nose. No objects or scenery. Cat fully inside every cell.
Top row, left to right: (1) sitting facing slightly right, open eyes, tail curved right; (2) exactly same sitting pose with both eyes peacefully closed for a blink; (3) sitting but compressed into a crouch ready to jump, eyes open.
Middle row, left to right: three sequential side-view running poses facing right, (4) front paw reaching forward and hind paw extended back; (5) paws tucked beneath body; (6) front paw tucked and hind paw reaching forward.
Bottom row, left to right: (7) side-view running with paws outstretched in a little leap; (8) a happy compact curled-ball pose suitable for spinning during a backflip; (9) sitting after landing, eyes happily closed, tail curled around paws.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: small empty-chat illustration for Neconyan, a cute calico-themed chat app.
Primary request: one irresistibly cute round calico cat curled asleep with its chin and paws on a small plush cream speech bubble. Closed happy eyes, little pink nose, plump soft paws, little curved tail, asymmetrical black and caramel patches on ivory fur, subtle blush inside ears. A small peach heart is tucked beside its tail.
Style: polished Japanese stationery illustration, hand-drawn dark cocoa outlines, flat matte cream, apricot peach, caramel brown, ink black and tiny soft blush-pink accents. Very simple chunky readable silhouette, a few delicate fur strokes. Charming rather than corporate or realistic. Crisp silhouette remains readable at 120 pixels wide.
Composition: one isolated compact vignette, horizontally balanced, centred with 16% clear margin on every side. All ears, paws and tail fully inside frame. No text, lettering, watermark, UI panel or square sticker border. No ground plane, shadows, glow, gradients or environment.
Background: perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 ONLY outside the vignette so the background can be cleanly removed. No green anywhere in the cat or objects. Do not draw a checkerboard. Preserve creamy-white fur and the warm dark outlines.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: four individual cute paw-print stamps for a calico-themed app background.
Create a precise2-by-2sheet on a1024x1024 canvas, one paw print per equal square cell, generous18%empty margin, no dividers or labels. Use the supplied calico illustration ONLY as a palette and softness reference. Do NOT draw any cat, face, ears, tail, limb, book, or object.
Each subject is a single unmistakable CAT PAW PRINT seen as a stamp: four small soft oval toe beans arched above one large rounded heart-like central paw pad. Five separate filled shapes in each paw, all five visible, anatomically legible. Friendly slightly asymmetric hand-drawn contours, simple flat matte ink, no outlines, no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows, no hard rectangular border. Soft rounded cute Japanese stationery aesthetic. Remains clear at32pixels wide.
Top left: warm ivory-cream paw print, leaning very slightly left.
Top right: blush-pink paw print, leaning very slightly right.
Bottom left: soft caramel-peach paw print, leaning slightly right.
Bottom right: warm ink-charcoal paw print, leaning slightly left.
Keep the four paws the same approximate scale and anatomy, with small natural contour variation. No extra scattered beans or confetti, no text, lettering or watermark.
Background outside all pads must be completely uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 for clean removal. No green within the prints. No checkerboard, no paper texture or environment. The green gaps between toe pads must remain open.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide background artwork behind the entire Neconyan chat application.
Primary request: a cute, muted pastel pink and purple kitty-cloud background.
Scene and subject: soft clouds shaped like sleepy round cats, with tiny cat ears and simple peaceful faces, drifting through a quiet blush-pink and lilac sky.
Style: original soft storybook illustration, rounded shapes, gentle matte colour, very low contrast and sparse detail.
Composition: wide 16:9 canvas, airy open centre, loosely scattered kitty clouds mainly around the outer edges. It must crop gracefully to a tall phone viewport.
Palette and mood: muted pastel pink, dusty lilac, pale lavender and warm cream; cosy, sleepy and calm.
Constraints: background artwork only, no UI, lettering, logos, borders or watermark. No sharp contrasts, saturated colours or busy patterns. The application will show the finished image at low opacity under its readable UI surfaces.
sources.processing: Converted to RGB WebP at quality 88; the application controls backdrop opacity in CSS.

sources.prompt: Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. Recreate the mood of the classic Windows Vista and Windows 7 default wallpapers: a deep blue background glowing from the centre, with luminous flowing aurora ribbons and soft glass light streaks in cyan, teal, aqua and a touch of green sweeping diagonally across the image, with tiny sparkling light particles and a gentle bokeh glow. On the right side, a gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) is curled up asleep, softly lit by the glowing light ribbons, with its tail curling into one of the light streaks, as if it were part of the glow. Painted in the same soft, gentle illustrated style as the first reference image (the cloud cats); the calico's markings follow the second reference image. Keep the centre-left of the image calm, darker blue and empty so text can sit over it. No text, no logo, no Windows flag, no watermark, no borders.

Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. Recreate the classic early-2000s Windows 'Bliss' wallpaper: a bright green rolling grassy hill under a vivid blue sky with soft white cumulus clouds. A gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) lies stretched along the crest of the hill on the right side, resting its chin on its paws, as if it were part of the landscape, tail draped down the slope. Painted in the same soft, gentle illustrated style as the first reference image (the cloud cats); the calico's markings follow the second reference image. Keep the centre-left of the image as calm open sky and grass with no details so text can sit over it. No text, no watermark, no borders.

Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. In the spirit of macOS Big Sur wallpapers: layered smooth rounded mountain ridges in soft dusk gradients of peach, cream and dusty lavender, a wide clear gradient sky. On the right ridge a gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) is curled up asleep like it is one of the hills, tail wrapped around itself. Smooth minimal vector-like shapes with soft painterly shading, same gentle style as the first reference image (the cloud cats); the calico's markings follow the second reference image. Keep the centre of the image calm and empty so text can sit over it. No text, no watermark.

Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. Extremely minimal: an almost empty very pale warm off-white background with a barely visible soft cream vignette. In the bottom right corner a small gigantic-feeling but simple line-and-flat-colour sleepy calico cat (white body with a few orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes) loafs peacefully, drawn with thin clean ink outlines and flat fills, like a modern minimalist illustration. Everything else is empty space. Same gentle sensibility as the first reference image (the cloud cats); the calico's markings follow the second reference image. No text, no watermark, no borders.

Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. A cosy warm evening scene: the soft-focus interior of a wooden cabin reading nook with a rain-speckled window on the far left, a glowing amber lamp, stacked books, a steaming mug and a knitted blanket. A gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) is curled up on the blanket at the bottom right, glowing in lamplight. Warm cocoa, parchment, honey and amber colours, soft painterly illustrated style like the first reference image (the cloud cats); the calico's markings follow the second reference image. Keep the centre of the image as a calm, low-detail warm wall so text can sit over it. No text, no watermark.

Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. A dark Linux-rice style wallpaper: deep charcoal night with a low horizon of dark misty mountains, a thin glowing neon gradient line along the ridge fading from warm peach-orange to soft pink, and faint glowing grid or particle dots. A gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) lies along the mountain ridge on the right, softly rim-lit by the neon glow, glowing edges on its fur. Moody, clean, minimal, cinematic; painterly style like the first reference image (the cloud cats); the calico's markings follow the second reference image. Keep the centre of the image dark and calm so text can sit over it. No text, no watermark.

Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. Flat design vector illustration: geometric low-detail slate-blue and grey-blue mountains in flat colour bands, a flat pale sky, simple flat clouds, no gradients or textures. A gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) rests along the mountains on the right, drawn in the same flat vector style with simple shapes and a couple of shading tones. Muted cool slate palette with the cat's warm orange as the only warm accent. Keep the centre of the image calm and low-detail so text can sit over it. The calico's markings follow the second reference image; gentle feeling like the first reference image. No text, no watermark.
